subject: StormLake onboarding calendar & responsibilities
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: David Park <david.park@stormlake.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: StormLake onboarding calendar & responsibilities

David —

Thanks again for the conversation last week and for signing the Statement of Work. Attached is a draft onboarding calendar that breaks down the first 10 weeks into milestones, owners, and target dates so we can align expectations. High level items included:

- Week 1: Kickoff & environment access (responsible: StormLake / Redwood IT)
- Week 2–3: Data mapping & ingestion validation (responsible: StormLake data team + Redwood integration lead)
- Week 4: Security review & SOC evidence exchange (responsible: StormLake security + Redwood compliance)
- Week 6: Internal acceptance tests + performance tuning (Redwood eng + StormLake SRE)
- Week 8–10: Pilot, training, and go-live readiness checklist (CS + PM)

I've attached "RL-Map-v1.xlsx" with a column for owners and acceptance criteria — please add any missing owners or adjust dates. If this looks good we can lock the timeline and schedule the first 60-minute kickoff (proposed: Wed 7/2 11:00–12:00 PT).

Open items I want to flag now:
- We need the S3 bucket + read-only credentials by 7/7 (ingestion team blocked without).
- StormLake requested SOC 2 artifacts; Marissa will follow up with the evidence packet.

Next steps: 1) You review the attached and confirm owners/dates, 2) Marissa will send a calendar invite for kickoff, 3) Karthik will follow with the tech checklist.

Thanks,
Chloe
Chloe Martin
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

Attachment: RL-Map-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: David Park <david.park@stormlake.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
Cc: StormLake Implementation <impl@stormlake.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: StormLake onboarding calendar & responsibilities

Chloe —

Thanks for the clear breakdown and for sharing the workbook. This format is helpful. A few notes from our side:

- We can target the kickoff on Wed 7/2 11:00 PT; I have invited our data lead (Maya) and security manager (Simon) to the call.
- We will provide a read-only S3 user by 7/9 (internal approval flows mean a couple days delay on our side). If that pushes data work to week 3, we can re-shift acceptance dates.
- On SOC 2: Simon asks if you can share a redacted evidence packet and the SOC 2 report. We attached a list of specific questions in the PDF.

Also: can you add a column in the MAP for "required customer pre-reqs" so our PM can track tasks that only StormLake can complete?

Appreciate it — looking forward to kickoff.

—David
David Park
Director, Data Platforms | StormLake Inc.
david.park@stormlake.com | +1 206-555-0104

Attachment: StormLake_Security_Questions.pdf (1 page)

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: David Park <david.park@stormlake.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 12:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: StormLake onboarding calendar & responsibilities

David —

Thanks — I'll update the workbook this afternoon to add a "Customer pre-reqs" column and shift data milestones if the S3 creds arrive on 7/9. Uploading version 1.1 to the shared Drive and will flag any downstream impacts to the acceptance dates.

For SOC 2: Marissa, can you confirm we can share a redacted evidence packet and the SOC 2 report PDF via the secure Drive folder? If yes we'll post a link and note which documents are stamped "for customer review" vs internal logs.

Proposed kickoff agenda (60 min):
1) Introductions & goals (10m)
2) Access & network plan (10m)
3) Data ingestion plan & file format expectations (20m)
4) Security artifacts & evidence exchange process (10m)
5) Next steps & owners (10m)

If that works for you, we'll send the invite.

Best,
Chloe

Hi David, Chloe —

I put together a short CS runbook and uploaded it to the Drive folder (link below). The runbook includes:
- Detailed acceptance criteria for each milestone
- Template test plans for data validation (CSV checksums, schema asserts)
- Security artifact handoff checklist (where we'll place SOC 2 report, pen test summary, and infra diagrams)
- Training plan for your ops and support teams (two 90-min sessions during the pilot window)

Action items for StormLake (pre-kickoff):
1) Confirm the two data owners and add contact info in the MAP (owner + backup).
2) Grant read-only S3 access or share a representative dataset by 7/9.
3) Review the security questions PDF and mark any follow-ups for the kickoff.

I'll schedule the kickoff for Wed 7/2 11:00 PT and include the Drive links and dial-in. If anyone needs a different time, reply-all and we'll update.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-stormlake-onboarding
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/SL-2025-074

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

David / team —

Thanks — I confirmed the engineering pre-kickoff checklist and added two items to the MAP:
- Network allowlist requirements (customer): please provide the IP ranges for any egress systems by 7/7.
- Representative sample dataset: if you can't provide S3 access by 7/9, share a 500-row sample CSV to unblock schema mapping.

I'll join the kickoff and will bring a short demo of the ingestion pipeline so you can see expected file naming and manifest behavior. If any of the dates in v1.1 look tight after Chloe updates them, call me and we'll reprioritize the initial validation tests so the pilot date remains unchanged.

Karthik Iyer
